body.label: Target
body.html: One enemy within melee Weapon Range after your movement.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Move up to 2 units through occupied allied spaces. On success, deal 1 Bludgeoning Damage and move 1 unit after the attack.

surges.html: You may pass through one enemy's space during the first movement, without ending there.
Until your next turn, the target cannot make movement Reactions against you on a hit.

rider.title: Combo - Blitz
rider.html: After resolving, spend 1 Combo to enter Otter Stance: standing from Prone costs you no die, but still requires your turn and room to stand.
